name: Sonoma County Transit: Paratransit
description: Paratransit rides near Sonoma County Transit routes
fullDescription: Sonoma County Transit provides ADA paratransit service for Sonoma County residents who cannot use regular bus service due to a disability.
whatTheyOffer:
- Shared ride service operated by Volunteer Wheels
- Service within 3/4 mile of Sonoma County Transit fixed routes
- Reservations from the next day up to 14 days in advance
- Zone-based fares; local paratransit along several local routes is fare-free
- Fare-free rides for veterans and college students with ID
- Wheelchair accessible vehicles
howToGetIt:
1. Complete the ADA Paratransit Service Eligibility Application (download at sctransit.com or call 707-565-7433)
2. Mail it or email it to sct-paratransit@sonomacounty.gov
3. Eligibility is decided within 21 days of a complete application
4. Once certified, book rides with Volunteer Wheels at 707-573-3377 or 800-992-1006
keywords: Sonoma County Transit, paratransit, ADA, Sonoma County, disability, wheelchair, door to door
